description: Reproducible 512x512 chest154-157 tint atlas; edited shade samples captured from approved 512px ATI2/BC5 DDS, while categorical dye layers come from the archived original 512px PLT.

shadeEdit.explanation: A quantized, recoverable shade source extracted from the approved BC5 output; this is not the original painter's layered editing file. All per-mip samples are stored to allow an exact rebuild without importing or depending on the committed DDS.
shadeEdit.pixelFormat: 8-bit grayscale top-to-bottom, base P5 512x512; lower mip samples concatenated 256x256 through 1x1
shadeEdit.samples: The edited shade source is paired with the original PLT category/layer plane without recoloring dye boundaries.
